distribution_model.detail: Sells frozen potato products to restaurants, foodservice operators and retailers via distributors; no direct consumer sales.

market_position.detail: Positions itself as a premium frozen potato supplier made from premium potatoes.

notes: Sells mainly to foodservice and retail channels, so consumer purchase frequency is inferred from restaurant and grocery fry demand.

product_category.detail: Frozen potato products: french fries, tots, sweet potatoes, appetizers and vegetable products.

purchase_frequency.detail: Fries and potato sides are regularly ordered by restaurants and bought as everyday food items.

sub_sector.value: frozen potato products for foodservice; frozen appetizers and vegetables
